title: Avoid needless repeated rules
summary: When the same rule appears in several places, changes can be missed. Put a shared rule in one clear function.
introduction: When the same rule appears in several places, changes can be missed. Put a shared rule in one clear function. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: When the same rule appears in several places, changes can be missed. Put a shared rule in one clear function.

blocks.code:
const passes = score => score >= 5;
console.log(passes(4), passes(7));
blocks.title: Avoid needless repeated rules

blocks.text: The output is false true. Both checks use the same passing rule.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a third call without copying the rule.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Two similar lines do not always represent the same rule; do not combine unrelated ideas.
For more detail later, use this [Clean Code further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/MDN/Writing_guidelines/Code_style_guide/JavaScript).
